figurative_meaning_en: to completely appropriate or absorb something for oneself
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পুরো সম্পত্তিটা ট্যাঁকে গোঁজা করেছে।
আমাদের অংশটুকু তারা ট্যাঁকে গোঁজা করে ফেলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has pocketed the entire property for himself.
They have tucked away our share completely.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali attire like dhoti or saree where items are tucked into the waistband
